name: Fireworks AI
summary: Fireworks AI runs open models quickly through a pay-per-token API that works with the OpenAI SDK.

free_plan_covers.note: Only a one-time $1 of free credit to get started; there is no ongoing free allowance.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No monthly plan; serverless inference is pay per token with postpaid billing.

portability.note: Provides an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1 (and an Anthropic-compatible one) serving open models, so code can move with a base URL and key change.

free_tier.note: No ongoing free tier; new accounts get a one-time $1 in free credits.

sdk_typescript.note: No Fireworks JavaScript or TypeScript SDK; the docs use the OpenAI or Anthropic npm packages pointed at Fireworks. The only Fireworks SDK is for Python, in alpha.

cheap_model_price.value: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B A3B: $0.05 input / $0.20 output per million tokens
cheap_model_price.note: Standard tier. Unlisted models under 4B parameters cost $0.10 per million tokens for input and output alike.

setup.step: Create an API key in the Fireworks dashboard.
Set the key as an environment variable.
Install the OpenAI SDK with npm install openai and set its base URL to https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1.
Call chat completions from a server-side route handler with a model id like accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p3-flash.

builder_notes: Keep FIREWORKS_API_KEY on the server only; never call the API from client-side code.
Billing is postpaid, so you are charged after use; cap max tokens per request to keep costs predictable.
Standard, Priority and Fast serverless tiers cost different amounts; the Standard tier is the cheapest.
